# Database Seed & Migration Scripts

This directory contains standalone Python and SQL scripts used to populate the MediaClub PostgreSQL database with initial community data, target clubs, custom channels, and Direct Messages.

---

### Files

* **`populate_data.py`**
  * Generates `seed_community.sql`.
  * Seeds 12 community accounts (including `sarah_cinema`, `alex_reads`, and `marcus_binge`), 15 main clubs (Movies, Series, Books), 4 standard channels per club, and Direct Message threads with recent timestamps.

* **`seed_community.sql`**
  * Ready-to-execute SQL script generated by `populate_data.py`.
  * Can be executed directly with `psql`:
    ```bash
    psql -U postgres -d mediaclub -f scripts/seed_community.sql
    ```

* **`populate_custom_channels.py`**
  * Generates `seed_custom_channels.sql`.
  * Generates 27 bespoke thematic channels across all clubs (e.g. `#book-vs-film`, `#theories-and-lore`, `#physics-and-black-holes`) populated with messages and emoji reactions.

* **`seed_custom_channels.sql`**
  * Ready-to-execute SQL script generated by `populate_custom_channels.py`.
  * Can be executed directly with `psql`:
    ```bash
    psql -U postgres -d mediaclub -f scripts/seed_custom_channels.sql
    ```

---

### Re-seeding the Database from Scratch

If you ever drop or reset your database, you can re-apply everything in two commands:

```bash
psql -U postgres -d mediaclub -f scripts/seed_community.sql
psql -U postgres -d mediaclub -f scripts/seed_custom_channels.sql
```
